title: Get started: Checklist (Before you trade real money)

f2.default: Open a demo account, follow our Telegram entries and practise the process. Go live only when it makes sense to you.

f3.default: A demo uses the same platform and prices, so everything you learn carries straight over.

f5.default: Place trades on MetaTrader with no money at risk.

f7.default: Use the structure, entry and stop-loss from each post.

f9.default: Risk a small, fixed share of your account per trade.

f11.default: Look back at every trade, including the losers.
